title: Very handy.
text: Very handy.. These lids are so handy. There are 6 different size lids. They are a thin plastic which makes it very easy to stretch...after I put one on the bowl, I pulled one of the tabs that comes on the lid and 'burped' it so the air came out. I held it sideways and nothing came out. There are 4 tabs on each lid, one on each side...makes it easy to hold on to as you put it on. They wash very easy..its mostly a rinse.

product_metadata.title: Adpartner 6PCS Rectangle Silicone Lids for Food Storage, Reusable BPA-free Silicone Stretch Lids in 6 Different Sizes to Fit Most Square and Rectangle Containers, Microwave Freezer Dishwasher Use Safe
features: Please CHECK THE SIZE details carefully before purchasing, this is very important as it determines the perfection of use! These rectangle silicone lids are better fit for square and rectangular containers. For reference: the largest size is 8.0*5.9 inches(20.5*15 cm), and the smallest size is 2.6*2.0 inches(6.5*5 cm).

Easy to Use & Strong Sealing - (Important!) Wipe the lid and container edges to keep them completely dry before use, as moisture will cause the lid slip off. Then stretch the silicone food lid to make it cover on container, the good flexibility can easy to create an air-tight vacuum seal on the container to keep food fresh. (Note: Overstretched also will cause slip-off even tore.)

Safety BPA-free Silicone Materials - These silicone stretch lids are made of food-grade silicone material, non-toxic and odorless, harmless and safe to touch with food directly. Heat resistance from 40°F up to 450°F that is safe for use in the fridge, microwave, and dishwasher.

Durable & Reusable - These food-grade silicone container lids are super flexible and tear-resistance, durable for stretching repeatedly. They are also easy to clean, you can just rinse them with warm soapy water or throw them in the dishwasher. These rectangle silicone food lids are a perfect complement for the disposable plastic wrap which can help you save a lot!

6 PCS Various Sizes & Multi-useful - These stretchable container covers are super practical, they are ideal for storing leftovers, taking dishes to potluck, stacking bowls, unfinished drinks, leftovers, fruits, and vegetables. Suitable to fit glass, plastic and metal containers. The six dimensions are 2.6*2.0 inches, 3.7*2.7 inches, 4.5*3.0 inches, 5.7*4.3 inches, 6.5*4.7 inches, and 8.0*5.9 inches respectively.
